sentinels.derived: computed from other quantities in this project
sentinels.measured_here: measured by this project from deposited coordinates
sentinels.method_choice: an algorithmic choice, not a measured quantity
sentinels.convention: a community convention rather than a measurement
sentinels.unverified: value in use but its source could not be confirmed

parameters.name: IP3 on-rate a1
parameters.description: Binding rate of IP3 to its site on one subunit.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Inhibitory Ca2+ on-rate a2
parameters.description: Binding rate of Ca2+ to the slow inhibitory site; sets the time scale of inactivation (Li-Rinzel h gate).
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Activating Ca2+ on-rate a5
parameters.description: Binding rate of Ca2+ to the fast activating site.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: IP3 dissociation constant d1
parameters.description: IP3 site affinity when the inhibitory site is empty.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Inhibitory Ca2+ dissociation constant d2
parameters.description: Inhibitory-site affinity with IP3 bound.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: IP3 dissociation constant d3
parameters.description: IP3 site affinity when the inhibitory site is occupied.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Activating Ca2+ dissociation constant d5
parameters.description: Activating-site affinity.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Active subunits to open
parameters.description: A channel conducts when this many of its four subunits are in the active state. The deterministic Li-Rinzel flux uses the cube of the subunit activity, i.e. three.
parameters.source_note: Li & Rinzel 1994 (the cubic exponent); Shuai & Jung 2002 use the same 3-of-4 rule for single stochastic channels

parameters.name: Maximal channel flux rate v1
parameters.description: Rate constant of IP3R-mediated release.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: ER leak rate v2
parameters.description: Passive leak from the ER.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: SERCA maximal rate v3
parameters.description: Maximal SERCA uptake.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: SERCA half-activation k3
parameters.description: Ca2+ at half-maximal SERCA uptake (Hill 2).
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Total cell Ca2+ c0
parameters.description: Total free Ca2+ referred to the cytosolic volume; conserved in the closed-cell model.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: ER/cytosol volume ratio c1
parameters.description: Ratio of ER to cytosolic volume.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Channels per cluster
parameters.description: Number of IP3Rs in the simulated cluster.
parameters.source_note: Order-of-magnitude choice: Smith & Parker 2009 resolve puffs made of a few to a few tens of channel openings; the cluster modelled here is a teaching default, not a measurement

parameters.name: Resting cytosolic Ca2+
parameters.description: Background Ca2+ each channel sees when no channel in the cluster is open.
parameters.source_note: The customary 100 nM resting level; the same value is the lower bound of the Li-Rinzel oscillation in its own figures

parameters.name: Cluster Ca2+ per open channel
parameters.description: Mean-field increment of the Ca2+ every channel in the cluster sees for each open channel — the coupling that turns a blip into a puff.
parameters.source_note: A mean-field simplification of Swillens et al. 1999, who show that puffs need inter-channel Ca2+ coupling; 1 uM per channel was chosen from a scan (0-2 uM at 0.05-0.2 uM IP3) as the value that most raises the Fano factor of simultaneous openings. The local nanodomain at an open pore is far higher and is not modelled

parameters.name: Puff simulation time step
parameters.description: Fixed step of the stochastic gate simulation.
parameters.source_note: Chosen so the fastest transition probability per step (a1 x IP3 or a5 x cluster Ca2+) stays below about 0.1 at the default parameters

parameters.name: ANM contact cutoff
parameters.description: C-alpha pairs closer than this are joined by a spring.
parameters.source_note: Atilgan et al. 2001 use 13-15 A; the upper end keeps a coarse-grained tetramer connected

parameters.name: ANM spring constant
parameters.description: Uniform stiffness scale; only eigenvalue ratios are reported.
parameters.source_note: Eigenvalues are arbitrary without a B-factor fit

parameters.name: ANM distance scale d0
parameters.description: Distance scale of the inverse-square spring weighting.
parameters.source_note: Yang et al. 2009 parameter-free ANM weighting

parameters.name: Modes computed
parameters.description: Non-trivial normal modes kept.
parameters.source_note: Enough to cover the collective motions; more only costs time

parameters.name: C-alpha stride
parameters.description: Keep every n-th C-alpha of each subunit.
parameters.source_note: A full tetramer is ~9,000 C-alphas; a stride of 3 keeps the shift-invert solve interactive while the low modes, which are collective by construction, are insensitive to it

parameters.name: C4 character tolerance
parameters.description: How close to an ideal character (+1, -1, 0) a mode must be to receive an irrep label.
parameters.source_note: Coarse-grained deposits are not perfectly symmetric; beyond this the mode is reported as mixed rather than forced into a label

parameters.name: Pore profile step
parameters.description: Axial sampling interval of the pore profile.
parameters.source_note: The value ip3r_genes S0 used, so the two profiles share a grid

parameters.name: Pore profile half-slab
parameters.description: Half-thickness of the slab in which the minimum heavy-atom distance to the axis is taken.
parameters.source_note: The value ip3r_genes S0 used for structure_pore.tsv

parameters.name: Lining-residue half-slab
parameters.description: Half-thickness of the slab searched for the residues forming a constriction.
parameters.source_note: As ip3r_genes S0

parameters.name: Lining-residue radial tolerance
parameters.description: Atoms within this distance of the minimum radius count as lining the constriction.
parameters.source_note: As ip3r_genes S0

parameters.name: Ligand contact cutoff
parameters.description: Heavy-atom distance at which a residue counts as an IP3 contact.
parameters.source_note: The cutoff ip3r_genes S0 and S22 used for the ten measured contacts

parameters.name: Numbering-check identity
parameters.description: Fraction of residues a structure must share, by number, with a reference sequence to be declared in that reference's numbering.
parameters.source_note: The rule ip3r_genes S24 (D64) applied before painting variants on structures; strict, because an offset still aligns most residues with something

parameters.name: Minimum column occupancy
parameters.description: A conservation score is used only where at least this fraction of (weighted) sequences have a residue in the column.
parameters.source_note: S17's MIN_OCCUPANCY, so re-derived AUCs are computed on the positions S17 scored

parameters.name: Geometry agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in a radius, residual or distance that still counts as reproducing the published value.
parameters.source_note: The published values are quoted to 0.01 A; 0.05 A allows for rounding and axis-fit differences and nothing else

parameters.name: Statistic agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in a re-derived AUC, mean or fraction that still counts as agreement.
parameters.source_note: Published tables round to four decimals; 0.002 allows for rounding and tie-handling differences
